classification.resume: This is a 1964 Swiss TV news broadcast (Tagesschau) covering two health-related stories: a U.S. Department of Health report on lung cancer and the approval of a leukemia serum by biologist Gaston Naessens in Paris. It includes footage of a speech by Kirlander from the U.S. Department of Health and a tobacco industry representative, as well as coverage of Naessens' departure from Paris.
